frames.text:
9:41                                      ▰  ▮▮  ▰
fancy
Before you leave.
Deleting your account will sign you out and hide your public profile and content.

Upcoming meals you host will be cancelled. You’ll leave upcoming meals and pending applications. Your contact consent, group access, AI preferences and active context will be removed.

Other members’ participation in meals already started is preserved. Remaining provider and content removal continues afterward under the approved policy.
Continue to verify identity
Keep my account
